rules.rule: Open on a hook type, never the project name, a spec line or 'Presenting'.
Use one comment-keyword CTA per lead-focused reel.
rules.type: evidence-checked; comments are not qualified leads

rules.rule: Put the specific number or fact in the first line, then add a new fact every 3 to 5 seconds.
rules.type: carried from project playbook v1; transcripts too few to verify here

rules.rule: Prefer a person on camera over brand-only visuals.
rules.type: carried from project playbook v1; presenter presence not measurable without video

segments.note: Analytical segments, not a requirement that every reel target all of them. Hook suggestions are creative hypotheses until tested on Indian audiences.
segments.under_construction: construction-spectacle and developer-math hooks (number first, then the build milestone).
segments.apartments_and_villas: rare-feature or audience call-out hooks; one unusual feature per reel.
segments.new_launches: audience call-out with a locality fact; avoid 'Presenting'.
segments.construction_updates: pattern-interrupt question about something visible on site.
segments.locality_and_infrastructure: place-and-transformation hook with a dated fact.
segments.investment_education: bold money number, then the arithmetic.
segments.first_time_homebuyers: audience call-out naming the commute or budget.
segments.families_upgrading: lifestyle story with one concrete room or school fact.
segments.nris_and_investors: rental yield or e-Khata explainer with a number.
segments.luxury: curiosity plus one rare feature; show restraint on specs.
